characters.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: five expressions of a specific game character. Image 2 is ONLY the rendering-style reference (ignore its green-haired character identity). Redraw ALL FIVE portraits of image 1 in the pixel-art style of image 2. Preserve the target character's identity, gender, age, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, accessories, outfit, composition and each facial expression. Hand-authored pixel clusters, no smooth illustration or mere pixel filter.
OUTPUT LAYOUT CRITICAL: exact landscape 1536x1024 PNG, invisible 3-column by 2-row grid of six 512x512 squares. Top row NORMAL / HAPPY / SURPRISED, bottom row SAD / WIN / EMPTY. Place ONE portrait within each of the first five cells. Bottom-right cell stays completely transparent. Head and shoulders, consistent large face scale and framing across all five. At least 20px padding INSIDE each cell; all hair and shoulders strictly inside their own cell, never touch cell edges. Transparent background throughout, including empty final cell, no glow, scenery, shadows, text, labels, borders or effects. Crisp alpha silhouettes. No floating stray pixels. Do not add hands.
Expressions: NORMAL composed gentle smile with open eyes; HAPPY big laughing smile with happy closed eyes; SURPRISED wide eyes and small open O mouth; SAD downturned mouth and dejected eyes; WIN triumphant grin with ONE winking eye. Same clothes/accessories in every expression.
Subject: Xiaocui, energetic young woman, emerald green long twin ponytails and soft bangs, turquoise green eyes, vivid pink ribbon bows at both ponytail roots, white blouse with a teal sailor-style collar.
Rendering: PC-98 anime visual novel pixel artwork: emulate 256x256 pixel portraits enlarged to 512 square by exactly 2x nearest neighbor. Restricted 16-color-looking palette, deep indigo contours, warm peach skin, slightly muted cel pigments, beautiful precise checkerboard ordered dithering and stippled shadow transitions. FINE deliberate jagged pixel outlines, detailed pixel eyes, angular hair clusters. Strong visible regular 2x2 pixel pattern in dithered shading, not smooth gradients. Follow reference image 2's detailed dithering aesthetic.
